name: legal-skills
description: Agent Skills (agentskills.io) for legal research and legal work.

plugins.name: federal-law
plugins.description: Find, read, and verify U.S. federal statutes and regulations from official sources: U.S. Code, CFR, Federal Register, public laws, and legislative history, with currency checks, as-of-date pulls, and pinpoint cites.

plugins.name: florida-citation
plugins.description: Format and check legal citations under Florida's Rule 9.800, with the Bluebook system through the public-domain Indigo Book for what the rule doesn't cover: the rule's text, Florida forms, case-number conversion, citations built from their parts, every citation in a brief or motion checked with its page, authority, and fix, and the other side's filing reviewed with facts and pinpoints ahead of form.
